title: Three-egg scramble with spinach on toast
summary: High in protein, low in cost.
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add a pinch of salt and pepper and beat with a fork until smooth.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat, add the spinach and stir for about a minute until it wilts.

Pour in the eggs and leave them for 20 seconds, then push them slowly across the pan with a spatula. Keep folding gently for 2 to 3 minutes until just set but still glossy, then take the pan off the heat: they keep cooking.
Meanwhile toast the bread and slice the tomato.
Pile the eggs on the toast and serve with the tomato.
